title: Top K Frequent Elements
statement:
Given an array of integers and a value K, return the K most frequent elements.

If two elements have the same frequency, the one with the smaller value comes first.

Output the K elements space-separated, ordered by frequency descending (then value ascending for ties).
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and K.
The second line contains N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: K space-separated integers: the K most frequent elements.
constraints:
1 <= K <= number of distinct elements <= N <= 10^4
-10^4 <= A[i] <= 10^4

examples.explanation: 1 appears 3 times, 2 appears 2 times. Top 2 are 1 and 2.
